# add_csd_to_rag_with_pbc { #mofography.compute.add_csd_to_rag_with_pbc }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-legacy">legacy</span> CSD descriptor is old and simple; env_cluster typing supersedes it. Use `add_env_cluster_pocket_types_to_rag` instead.

```python
compute.add_csd_to_rag_with_pbc(rag, props, pbc_groups, bins, ase_atoms, shape)
```

Attach PBC-aware cavity-size distribution (CSD) histograms to RAG nodes.

Histograms are centroid-to-void-voxel distances with periodic boundary handling.
Stored as ``csd_x_pbc`` / ``csd_y_pbc``.  Also sets ``centroid_pbc`` on nodes.
